name: Quantum Conscience
source: Within a galaxy of terraformed planets, a secret war rages between two intergalactic agencies. One of them—ARCHON—is developing the technology to invade people’s minds. They have already tyrannized a planet called Teballai, and hope to use their mind-reading technology to spread their power across the galaxy. A second organization—FOE (Freedom Organization of Elites)—wants to destroy ARCHON’s technology in the name of freedom. When a young FOE soldier (you choose the gender) named Blaire obtains the ability to read minds from an ARCHON experiment, she finds her loyalty torn between both sides. Whether Blaire helps the enemy or defeats them depends upon your use of her power.
translation: 在一个由改造行星组成的星系中，两个星际机构之间正在爆发一场秘密战争。其中之一——ARCHON——正在开发侵入人们思想的技术。他们已经统治了一颗名为特巴拉伊的星球，并希望利用他们的读心技术将他们的力量传播到整个银河系。第二个组织——FOE（自由精英组织）——想要以自由的名义摧毁ARCHON的技术。当一位名叫布莱尔的年轻敌人士兵（性别由你选择）从执政官实验中获得读心术的能力时，她发现自己的忠诚在双方之间左右为难。布莱尔是帮助敌人还是击败他们取决于你如何使用她的力量。
